metadata.name: htop
metadata.summary: View and manage system processes interactively in the terminal

content.value: htop is a cross-platform, ncurses-based interactive process viewer written in C. It provides a real-time, dynamic overview of active system processes alongside core system metrics such as CPU consumption, memory usage, load averages, and swap space.

Unlike traditional system monitors, htop offers a user-friendly text interface with vertical and horizontal scrolling to inspect complete command lines, accompanied by an interactive setup menu to customize displayed meters and columns.

items.value: Vertical and horizontal list scrolling to inspect complete command lines
System-wide resource tracking for CPU cores, memory, load average, and swap usage
Hierarchical tree view toggle to visualize parent-child process relationships
Interactive process search and real-time filtering
Convenient process management such as killing and renicing tasks directly without manual PID entry
Configurable display meters and sortable columns through a graphical setup screen
